en: Black-and-white view over a rocky seaside harbor with small boats and a ferry docked at a pier. The scene shows low barren islands in the distance, simple wooden buildings near the pier, and canoes or small boats pulled up onto the rocks and grass in the foreground. The word "BRÄNNÖ." appears at the bottom left, and a triangular publisher's logo with the number 5234 is printed at the bottom right.
